tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. The mark's home ground in the Dark theme.

tokens.name: ground-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, code blocks. Always bordered with rule, never shadowed.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: 1px borders and dividers between regions.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and interface icons on ground and ground-raised. 4.5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, labels and the tagline on ground and ground-raised. 4.5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The brand colour: the mark, display type 24px and larger, one primary action per page. On the Light theme it is below 4.5:1 against ground, so never body or small text there.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on any gold fill, in both themes.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Links, selected states, a second data series. From the spokes of the reference drawing. 4.5:1 on ground in both themes.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Page titles and the cover name. Spectral semibold, never bold.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Everything is an immutable value, every function is pure.
styles.usage: Running text, in ink on ground. Keep near 65 characters wide.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: Both pass the same conformance suite.
styles.usage: Secondary copy, table cells, captions in ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and chips, in ink-muted.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name beside the mark, in ink. Scales with the lockup; keep the weight.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and inline identifiers, on ground-raised. Tabular numerals for any column of digits.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The spoke cut on the cover; gaps between chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between the mark and the wordmark; between label and value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding, list item spacing.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a row.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections of a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap above a major heading.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips and code spans.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, image frames and the cover blocks.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: The app-icon tile at 100px; scale with the tile.
